workflow_runs.display_title: test_ndt_serve: the claim-note case no longer depends on TMPDIR's length

head_commit.message:
test_ndt_serve: the claim-note case no longer depends on TMPDIR's length

The case built its note from two paths under the test's temp directory, so
with a TMPDIR of about 55 characters or more the note went past the 200-character
limit and the server answered 400 before the case tested anything.
